mapper.insert: insert into class_timetable ( semester, row_class_name, class_name, weekday, section_code, section_text, start_section, end_section, course_name, teacher, week_raw, week_text, week_expanded, classroom ) values ( #{semester}, #{rowClassName}, #{className}, #{weekday}, #{sectionCode}, #{sectionText}, #{startSection}, #{endSection}, #{courseName}, #{teacher}, #{weekRaw}, #{weekText}, #{weekExpanded}, #{classroom} )
mapper.select: select config_key as configKey, schedule_enabled as scheduleEnabled, cron_expression as cron, semester, semester_start_date as semesterStartDate, date_format(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt from timetable_integration_config where config_key = #{configKey}
mapper.insert: insert into timetable_integration_config ( config_key, schedule_enabled, cron_expression, semester, semester_start_date, updated_at ) values ( #{configKey}, #{scheduleEnabled}, #{cronExpression}, #{semester}, #{semesterStartDate}, now() ) on duplicate key update schedule_enabled = values(schedule_enabled), cron_expression = values(cron_expression), semester = values(semester), semester_start_date = values(semester_start_date), updated_at = now()
mapper.select: select id, trigger_type as triggerType, status, scope, source, success_account as successAccount, attempts, updated_count as updatedCount, date_format(started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startedAt, date_format(finished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as finishedAt, error_message as error, output, log_path as logPath from timetable_import_job order by started_at desc, id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into timetable_import_job ( id, trigger_type, status, scope, source, success_account, attempts, updated_count, started_at, finished_at, error_message, output, log_path, config_id ) values ( #{id}, #{triggerType}, #{status}, #{scope}, #{source}, #{successAccount}, #{attempts}, #{updatedCount}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{error}, #{output}, #{logPath}, (select id from timetable_integration_config where config_key = 'lab-admin-class-timetable') )
mapper.update: update timetable_import_job set status = #{status}, success_account = #{successAccount}, attempts = #{attempts}, updated_count = #{updatedCount}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, error_message = #{error}, output = #{output}, log_path = #{logPath} where id = #{id}

update timetable_import_job set status = 'failed', finished_at = current_timestamp, error_message = '后端已重启，之前的采集任务已中断，请查看日志后重试' where status = 'running' and source = 'class-all' and config_id = (select id from timetable_integration_config where config_key = 'lab-admin-class-timetable')
mapper.select: select config_key as credentialKey, credential_username_cipher as usernameCipher, credential_password_cipher as passwordCipher, date_format(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt from timetable_integration_config where config_key = #{credentialKey}
mapper.insert: insert into timetable_integration_config ( config_key, schedule_enabled, cron_expression, credential_username_cipher, credential_password_cipher, updated_at ) values ( #{credentialKey}, false, '0 0 */6 * * *', #{usernameCipher}, #{passwordCipher}, now() ) on duplicate key update credential_username_cipher = values(credential_username_cipher), credential_password_cipher = values(credential_password_cipher), updated_at = now()
mapper.update: update timetable_integration_config set credential_username_cipher = null, credential_password_cipher = null, updated_at = now() where config_key = #{credentialKey}
